notes: CORRECTION to existing reference-only Pebbles/Onyx identity row: the Warcraft Wiki prospecting section explicitly lists Handful of Pebbles as an input yielding Ostentatious Onyx. Exact output item ID 212511 is independently confirmed by the item-specific TradeSkillMaster retail page https://tradeskillmaster.com/retail/us/items/212511 (item title Ostentatious Onyx). This fixes only outputItemID; no new independent cast cohort. Wowhead Onyx specialization trait https://www.wowhead.com/profession-trait/onyx-98661 says an Onyx can replace Ambivalent Amber by specialization; unlock/skill/proc context for the Pebbles source is not given. Input batch, completed operations, hit counts, zero outcomes, stack sizes, output rank, profession skill, game build and Resourcefulness/refunds all remain unknown. Reference only: never imply 100% chance, numerical yield, live-gold EV or estimator eligibility.
